endorsements.name: Dan Geer
endorsements.label: Cybersecurity as Realpolitik
endorsements.description: Power exists to be used. Some wish for cyber safety, which they will not get. Others wish for cyber order, which they will not get. Some have the eye to discern cyber policies that are "the least worst thing;" may they fill the vacuum of wishful thinking.
endorsements.subtitle: Black Hat Usa 2014

evidence-links.title: Cybersecurity as Realpolitik by Dan Geer presented at Black Hat USA 2014

povs.explanation: The speaker’s proposal was accepted through the conference’s independent review process. We could not verify whether the work is used in industry in situations of real consequence.
